name: UP Post-Matric Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement
authority: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
eligibility: Students enrolled in Class 11, 12, Graduate, Postgraduate, Diploma, BTech, or Medical programs in UP recognized institutions.
benefit: 100% tuition fee reimbursement plus monthly maintenance allowance (up to ₹50,000/year depending on course).
application_process: Online registration on UP Scholarship Portal -> Upload marksheet, income/caste certificate, fee receipt -> Institute verification -> DBT bank transfer.
required_documents: Bank Account linked with Aadhaar (NPCI mapped)

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students (CSSS)
authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt of India
eligibility: Students above 80th percentile in relevant stream in Class 12 board exams, pursuing regular degree courses (BTech, BSc, BA, MBBS).
benefit: ₹12,000 per annum for Graduation (first 3 years) and ₹20,000 per annum for Post-Graduation.
application_process: Register via National Scholarship Portal (NSP) with Aadhaar and OTR -> Institute and State nodal verification -> Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
authority: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable landholding in their names (subject to exclusion criteria).
benefit: ₹6,000 per year directly to bank account in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months via DBT.
application_process: Online application on PM-KISAN portal or through CSC centers -> Land record validation -> e-KYC via Aadhaar OTP.

name: UP Chief Minister Abhyudaya Yojana (Free Coaching)
authority: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
eligibility: Students of Uttar Pradesh preparing for UPSC, UPPSC, JEE, NEET, NDA, CDS examinations.
benefit: Free high-quality coaching by IAS/IPS officers and subject experts, physical and virtual classes, and study materials.
application_process: Register online at abhyuday.up.gov.in -> Online eligibility test -> Seat allocation in district centers.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
authority: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
eligibility: Female students admitted to 1st year of Degree/Diploma program in an AICTE approved institution (max 2 girls per family).
benefit: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college fees, computer, books, and stationeries.
application_process: Submit application on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) -> Verification by AICTE recognized college.
